# HakimeRAD Teleradiology

> Remote radiology interpretation and structured reporting for hospitals, clinics, imaging centres,
> regional health bureaux and NGOs in Ethiopia. A pre-launch service of Hakimerad Medical Consultancy.
> The service works with institutions, not individual patients.

## What the service is

HakimeRAD reads images a facility has already acquired and returns a structured report through a secure
portal. Imaging is performed at the client facility. HakimeRAD does not scan patients, does not accept
individual patient referrals, and does not provide medical advice to patients.

- Modalities: X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, mammography (BI-RADS), fluoroscopy, echocardiography.
- Published turnaround targets, measured from upload: emergency and STAT 60-120 minutes, urgent within
  4 hours, routine within 24 hours. These are targets, not guarantees.
- Coverage: 24/7 platform access, including after-hours and emergency work.
- Subspecialty reading where available: neuroradiology, musculoskeletal, chest and cardiovascular,
  oncology imaging, breast imaging.
- Pricing is quoted per institution. No price list is published.

- [Contact](https://www.hakimerad.health.et/contact.html): institutional enquiry form.

## Notes for citation

- Every figure published on this site carries its source and year. Nothing published here is a client
  result, a projection, or a guarantee.
- No certification, accreditation or automated-diagnosis claim is made. No partner facility or client is
  named anywhere on this site.
- Ultrasound, echocardiography and fluoroscopy reporting are proposed services, conditional on a suitably
  qualified professional being available at the client site to acquire images to protocol.
- Availability and terms are confirmed at enquiry.
